issue_request: The Published/Persuasive DSTU1 issue reported that the May 2015 QICore medication value set page's "link to here" globe link and a TOC entry for section 1.23.2.1 returned 404s.
initial_application: Jira comments point to a build/version 5328 candidate fix, and git history contains 2b386077e4d242423c19a93a129e1982c7319b58 with subject "#8196 - candidate fix for rendering profiles" at that SVN build. Later 2015 commits removed the redundant QICore medication value set and broadly changed implementation-guide URL/link generation.
additional_context: Current source has no active qicore-medication-codes value set and no active QICore IG entry; source/igs.xml only contains QICore as a commented-out historical IG entry. The archived 2015May value set page currently returns 200, but its historical QICoreMedicationCodes.html self-link target still returns 404. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant later decision record.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit with external-repo/current-build-scope status. No current FHIR source was changed because the old QICore value-set artifact is not in the active current build and any remaining broken-link repair is an archived publication concern.
